title: Line of Sight Access
text: Determine line of sight (LOS) access between one or more source positions and one or more target positions, 11 inputs, 6 outputs, {Ephemeris model} sets Ephemeris model; {Units} sets the parameter and port units Metric, {Time source}, {Start date/time (JD)} sets the initial start date and time for simulation, {Access calculation type} sets the method to control access, {Output access status for each occulting body}, {Limit ephemerides date range} sets the option to enable start and end of range of ephemeris, {Start date (JD)} sets the start date of ephemerides date range, {End date (JD)} sets the end date of ephemerides date range, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Central body} sets the celestial central body for source position, {Include Moon} sets the option to include Moon, {Include Earth} sets the option to include Earth, {Position coordinate frame}, {Minimum elevation angle (deg)}, {Input Moon libration angles}, {Use Earth orientation parameters (EOPs)} sets the option to use Earth orientation parameters, {IERS EOP data file} sets the earth orientation data, {Equatorial radius} sets the custom equatorial radius 3.3962e6, {Use field of view (FOV)} sets the option to specify field of view, {FOV half angle (deg)} sets the field of view half angle, {Attitude representation}, {FOV orientation source} sets the field of view orientation source method, {FOV orientation} sets the field of view orientation, {Attitude reference coordinate frame}, {Angle rotation order} and {Use same central body as Source} sets the option to use same central body as specified for source. Values come from the instance.
